task.title: N5 plan review corrections before owner approval: reference-condition provenance, B2 protected capture, examined-scope uniqueness, blank viewport, deadline enforcement and conditional closure
task.objective: Revise docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/N5-visual-failure-diagnosis.md for six review findings without implementing N5 or ratifying owner decisions: audit the VisualEvidence and reference-store formats and define a fail-closed, non-migrating condition rule; trace every caller of StepExecutor.captureFailureEvidence and add the reproducible real-browser security verifier verify:b2-protected-capture, registering a confirmed reachable defect in Beads and KNOWN_ISSUES for a separate remediation; scope identity codes to examined DOM-named candidates with truncation and omitted-contender controls; define one bounded protected-guarded frame policy for blank viewports; define cancellation, cleanup and teardown for the deadline; and define truthful tracking for report-only closure, including the N5.7 edges.

acceptance.description: The N5 plan resolves findings 1-6 in place, with an index table, an evidence-backed provenance audit and fail-closed rule, the B2 finding with its reproduction result, examined-scope vocabulary, UI copy and controls, a single bounded frame policy, the abort-and-settle deadline protocol, the conditional closure table, an updated verification and mutation matrix, and an explicit list of unresolved owner decisions VD-0 to VD-11 that are proposed and not ratified.

Every caller of StepExecutor.captureFailureEvidence is traced and verify:b2-protected-capture reproduces the reachable paths in real Chromium with preconditions and ordinary-page controls; the confirmed defect is registered in Beads and KNOWN_ISSUES for a separate remediation; no capture is weakened and no product source changes.
Governance and state documents record the corrections, the bead updates and edges are exported, the new verifier is classified, the dashboard pins match the measured counts and report Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.
